episode_summary: Kelsey Caputo shares her insights on leveraging AI in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the irreplaceable value of local knowledge. She discusses her unique approach as a REALTOR and general contractor, highlighting the importance of transparency and relationship-building with high-net-worth clients. The episode provides actionable tactics for using AI to enhance client interactions and target marketing efforts.
